members.author: claxman
members.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Per-request timeout logic in Protocol._setupTimeout/resetTimeoutOnProgress doesn't correctly enforce maxTotalTimeout as a hard cap: the initial timer arms using the full per-request `timeout` instead of min(timeout, maxTotalTimeout), and the progress-triggered reset doesn't track elapsed start time, so a hung request with a small maxTotalTimeout can wait far longer than intended and/or the remaining budget is computed incorrectly after a progress notification.
